blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Senate has realigned P19.8 billion from the Medical Assistance Program (MAP) and the Assistance to Individuals in Crisis Situations (AICS) to increase the subsidy for PhilHealth under the proposed 2027 national budget, Sen. JV Ejercito said in a statement on Wednesday. With the realignment, Ejercito, chair of the Senate Committee on Finance, noted that the PhilHealth subsidy has increased from P73 billion to P94.2 billion, bringing the allocation closer to Ejercito’s target of P100 billion to strengthen healthcare coverage and ensure that more Filipinos benefit from the Universal Health Care (UHC) Act. “As the author and principal […]...
